company.name: OpenFX
company.shortDescription: OpenFX provides a real-time cross-border payment infrastructure that provides liquidity across different trading pairs.
company.description: OpenFX is a fintech company that develops cross-border payments and foreign exchange infrastructure for businesses. It provides a real-time settlement network designed to improve international payment processes compared to traditional systems. The platform includes FX liquidity, treasury management, and embedded financial services delivered through APIs to support business operations. Its technology focuses on connecting domestic payment networks and improving transaction routing across regions. The company also works on expanding its infrastructure, including solutions that incorporate digital asset technologies.
company.headquarters: New City, New York, United States
